content.introduction: The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) is a nonprofit research services company founded in 2019 with headquarters in Washington, DC, United States. Its mission is to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through fact-based economic and policy research. LISEP focuses on new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living to provide a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans. Recent reports from LISEP indicate a decline in weekly earnings for the second consecutive quarter and an increase in "functional unemployment," particularly affecting Black and Hispanic workers.

# Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity
ID: oKrdBOHsNfNr
Website: www.lisep.org
Headquarters: Washington , DC, United States
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/ludwig-institute-for-shared-economic-prosperity · 764 followers
Industry: Research Services
Company type: Nonprofit
Founded: 2019 [...] Description: LISEP Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity is a company that aims to achieve shared economic prosperity for all Americans, particularly for middle- and low-income families. Their focus is on fact-based economic and policy research.

The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was created in 2019 by Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig. The mission of LISEP is to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP's original economic research includes new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living. These metrics aim to provide policymakers and the public with a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans, [...] WASHINGTON, July 22, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Weekly earnings declined for the second straight quarter, and 'functional unemployment,' while slightly improved in June, has remained at or above 24% for five consecutive months. Conditions are particularly worsening for Black and Hispanic workers, according to a new report from the Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP).

(PRNewsfoto/Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity)

The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was created in 2019 by Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig. The mission of LISEP is to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP's original economic research includes new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living. These metrics aim to provide policymakers and the public with a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans, [...] WASHINGTON, June 18, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- The percentage of American workers unable to secure full-time, above-poverty-wage jobs continues to tick upward, with nearly one-fourth now classified as "functionally unemployed," according to the latest report from the Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP).
